sections.heading: C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Five Driving Basics
sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Five Driving Basics

FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A01
Eyes judge light, gaps, speed, and signs while ears track horns, sirens, bikes, and skids, and both ears must stay uncovered [A01].
Why it matters: group senses; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F01, sec05-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A01
Tiredness dulls sense and speed, medications can sedate or impair, and doctors must report risky conditions from age fourteen [A01].
Why it matters: group fitness; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F03, sec05-F05, sec05-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A01
Both hands stay planted by default, and push-pull keeps them at nine-three or eight-four without ever crossing center [A01].
Why it matters: group steering; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F07, sec05-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A02
Cross arms only for slow turns, parking, and skid recovery, and drop to one hand only for backing at twelve or for forced control use [A02].
Why it matters: group steering; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec05-F09, sec05-F10, sec05-F11, sec05-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A02
Drivers signal moves four ways with lamps or arms, and cyclists answer with one straight arm toward the turn [A02].
Why it matters: group signaling; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F14, sec05-F15 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A03
Signal numbers pair up: one hundred feet for turns and five seconds for freeway lane changes, plus curbs, empty roads, and late intersection turns, then cancel [A03].
Why it matters: group signaling; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F16, sec05-F17, sec05-F18 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A03
Horns warn of presence and danger on blind mountain bends, while high beams drop for oncoming and followed traffic by set distances [A03].
Why it matters: group horn-lights; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F19, sec05-F20 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A03
Headlights answer darkness clocks and weather, murk, mountains, signs, and low sun together [A03].
Why it matters: group horn-lights; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec05-F21, sec05-F22 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A04
Hazard ahead means warn behind three ways, trouble means clear the road and park visibly, and then wait inside for rescue [A04].
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec05-F23, sec05-F24, sec05-F25, sec05-F26 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]
